stories.title: Brewers rally from 4-0 down to beat Rays 5-4 in WS Game 2; lead series 2-0
stories.angle: Milwaukee erased a 4-0 deficit Saturday night to win Game 2, 5-4, and take a commanding 2-0 World Series lead over Tampa Bay. Cooper Pratt's go-ahead RBI single in the 7th inning gave the Brewers the lead; Aaron Ashby worked the final 5 outs and stranded the tying run at third in the ninth. Series shifts to Tropicana Field for Game 3 on Monday at 7 PM CT. Cubs' division rival is two wins from a title.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
FOUR RUNS DOWN. Milwaukee didn't blink.

Brewers beat Tampa 5-4 to take a 2-0 WS lead. Pratt's go-ahead RBI in the 7th. Ashby locked down the final outs. Cubs watching their division champ close in on a title.

Game 3: Monday at Tropicana, 7 PM CT.

**Decision:** FOLLOW UP on PCA coverage, but with NEW ANGLE (specific awards not yet covered)
**Sub-story 2a: Sporting News MLB Player of the Year**
**Key Facts:**
- PCA wins 2026 Sporting News MLB Player of the Year
- Voted by players (~260 players, 18 executives participated in voting)
- First Cub to win the Sporting News award since Sammy Sosa in 1998
- This is NOT the BBWAA MVP — the Sporting News award is a separate honor, voted by peers
- BBWAA NL MVP announcement: early November (after World Series)
- PCA also won: Baseball Digest Player of the Year, Baseball America Player of the Year (Oct 6-7, first Cubs player in 28-year award history)
- 2026 PCA stats: .280/.372, 45 HR, 107 RBI, 119 R, 41 SB, 10.4 fWAR, 162 games
- 7th player in MLB history with 40+ HR, 40+ SB season
**Sources:**
- On Tap Sports Net (Oct 22): "Pete Crow-Armstrong Named Sporting News MLB Player of the Year" ✅
- Yardbarker (Oct 22): same story ✅
- CubsHQ: "Pete Crow-Armstrong wins MLB Player of the Year honor after historic season" ✅
- Bleacher Nation (Oct 6): Baseball America award
- **Freshness note:** Source articles from Oct 22 (3 days ago). Per engine 24h rule, this is borderline. Rationale for inclusion: (a) BCB/Cubs news roundup covering these awards appears to be published today; (b) story was not covered in pipeline during its Oct 22 announcement window; (c) BBWAA MVP drop is imminent — today's angle is the award sweep building to that.
**Sub-story 2b: Fielding Bible Awards**
**Key Facts:**
- Announced: October 22, 2026
- PCA: Wins Fielding Bible Defensive Player of the Year (overall player vote). Narrowly lost CF award to Boston's Ceddanne Rafaela on tiebreaker (Rafaela had 21 DRS vs. PCA's 16 DRS; PCA won Player of Year on points)
- Alex Bregman: Wins Fielding Bible 3B Award — first Cubs third baseman in award history; 11th MLB season; 15 DRS led all 3Bs
- Chicago Cubs: Win Fielding Bible Team of the Year for 2nd consecutive season — 115 DRS, 28 more than any other team; Rays 2nd with 87

stories.title: Cubs sweep Fielding Bible Awards — PCA Defensive POY, Bregman 3B, Team of Year
